press_references.value: Graph Safety now available on Google Cloud Marketplace for AI-Native Pharmacovigilance Operations

product_launches.description: Graph AI has launched its flagship Graph Safety Suite on Google Cloud Marketplace, making its AI-native pharmacovigilance platform immediately available for enterprise procurement and deployment on Google Cloud infrastructure.

overview_description.description: Graph AI develops an AI-based pharmacovigilance platform that supports patient safety and regulatory operations across the pharmaceutical lifecycle. Its platform automates safety-data intake, case processing, evidence organization, validation, and regulatory reporting while connecting information through a unified knowledge graph. Products include tools for ingesting and classifying safety cases, building submission-ready case records, generating E2B(R3) reports, identifying safety signals, and maintaining audit trails and regulatory compliance. The system incorporates human review and oversight throughout workflows, allowing clinical and regulatory teams to validate information, review decisions, and manage exceptions.
